text:
Still building the file manager I've always wanted: https://intestinate.com/gusco/

Added an audio player this past month for all fellow file hoarders out there.

Also, you can now choose if you want Gusco to live in your terminal or run as a native-yet-texty app.

Was pleasantly surprised how well turning a Bubble Tea TUI app into a GUI-ish bundle works with Gio UI.
